common_required_outputs: All unthinned spike records over the complete target run, with original timestamps/IDs retained
Explicit physical-time and global-cell mappings; full population counts and area identities
Pinned model parameters, normalization/reference inputs and analysis source identities
Per-rank construction/event counts, source/runtime/layout identity, hashes and completion receipts
All-rank exit status, resource evidence and end-to-end timing
analysis_conventions: Unchanged frozen scientific protocol; no window/selection/precision/margin relaxation
auxiliary_output_policy: Retain Rust voltage traces, final states/refractory/counters and event copies; charge all actual work and storage. Do not impose an identical restart representation on NEST.
common_durability: Required event streams and metadata must be synchronized, independently verified and covered by successful all-rank termination; fadvise is advisory
time_policy: Primary external job wall includes initialization, simulation and all actual auxiliary/common output, verification and terminal completion. Collection/archive/analysis reported separately with total task cost.
acceptance_scope: A comparable scientific recording workload, not identical engine output bytes or proof of scientific/statistical/performance/cost acceptance
